selected_problem: Fresh-main inspection found that runAcceptance delegated validation commands to runCommand without overriding environment inheritance. runCommand merged process.env into every spawned shell, so autonomous validation commands inherited parent API tokens, session credentials and other ambient secrets even though those values were unrelated to validation evidence.

decision_provenance.mode_route_basis: The committed four-mode router selects DEEP_DEVELOPMENT through the singular evidence-rich bottleneck gate; no mode rotation was forced.
decision_provenance.claim_limit: No hosted DWAC success receipt is claimed. Selection/routing come from committed DWAC source-contract replay over the fresh canonical main while the hosted Developer Execution Runtime remained transiently unavailable.

pre_fix_reproduction.ambient_secret_inheritance: PASS reproduced on canonical base as a vulnerability witness: set TAOWIND_VALIDATION_SECRET=classified-value in the parent process, execute a validation command that prints that variable, and the child validation shell returned classified-value.

changes: runCommand now supports inheritProcessEnv=false while preserving existing callers through the default inheritProcessEnv=true behavior.

runAcceptance constructs a bounded validation environment containing only execution basics such as PATH, platform shell variables, home/temp paths, locale and CI markers, then invokes validation commands with process-environment inheritance disabled.

Persistent interactive terminal sessions retain their previous environment behavior; the new isolation is scoped to autonomous acceptance validation rather than silently changing user-driven terminal semantics.
Regression coverage proves ordinary npm/node validation still executes while undeclared parent variables and a representative GITHUB_TOKEN are absent from the validation environment.
truth_boundaries: This closes ambient process-environment inheritance for acceptance validation; it is not an OS-level sandbox.

Validation commands can still access filesystem paths permitted to the Taowind Code process, including user-level tool configuration files outside the workspace; workspace confinement remains unresolved.
The safe validation environment is intentionally conservative and may require future evidence-driven additions for toolchains that depend on non-secret environment variables.
Arbitrary complex repository semantic synthesis remains UNRESOLVED.
Filesystem crash-level atomicity for arbitrary I/O/process failure remains unresolved.
No GitHub Actions were intentionally triggered or rerun, no force push was used, and no credential, payment, formal Release or destructive/irreversible external action was performed.
